# Personal Website Redesign Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Replace the Jupyter Book in `indranilrc/home` with a hand-designed static personal site (Home, Research, Publications, CV, hidden Writing) generated by a small Python build from the public CV, deployed by GitHub Actions.

**Architecture:** `tools/import_cv.py` reads the public CV `.tex` files locally, strips SLB-internal markup, and writes `content/generated/*.json`. `build.py` merges those with hand-edited YAML sidecars and Markdown posts, renders Jinja2 templates to `_site/`, and copies static assets. A GitHub Actions workflow runs the build and deploys `_site/` to Pages.

**Tech Stack:** Python 3.11+ (CI) / 3.13 (local), Jinja2, PyYAML, Markdown (python-markdown), pytest; vanilla CSS and JS; self-hosted IBM Plex WOFF2; `actions/deploy-pages`.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-26-personal-website-redesign-design.md` (read it before starting; section numbers below refer to it).

## Global Constraints

- Public CV only: `$CV/IndranilRoychoudhury_CV.tex` and its section files. Never read `*_CV_SLB*`, CNP, or PSE files.
- Forbidden strings anywhere in `_site/` or `content/`: `IDF-`, `eureka`, `sharepoint`, `stic.slb.com`, `degreed`, plus the hashed client/program-name denylist in `tests/hygiene.py`, `internal`. (Check case-insensitively, except allow `internal` inside the word `international`.)
- Anti-brag (spec §2, §5.4): no citation counts, h-index, i10, "first-named inventor", "highest individual honor", stat badges, or logo strips anywhere on the site.
- Copy: US English, no em dashes (`—`) anywhere in rendered HTML, humanize rules; no "passionate", "cutting-edge", "leverag*", "innovative", "revolutioniz*".
- Colors (spec §6): light `#ffffff/#141414/#565656/#e2e2e2/#0b6e69`; dark `#14171a/#e8e6e1/#b4b0a7/#2a2e33/#d9a441`.
- Fonts: IBM Plex Sans 400/500/600 and IBM Plex Mono 400, WOFF2, self-hosted, `font-display: swap`. No requests to third-party origins from any page.
- All internal links go through the `base_path` from `content/site.yml` (`/home` until the domain move, then `""`).
- No commit to `main` and no push without Indranil's go-ahead; work on branch `redesign`. Commit subjects start with `[AI-GEN] `, with no `Co-Authored-By` trailer (user's CLAUDE.md overrides the harness default).

## Review Focus

1. **LaTeX residue:** accents, `\&`, `--`, `~`, `` ``…'' ``, `$\vert$`, and nested braces must render as clean typography, never raw backslashes or braces. Pinned in Task 2 (`test_no_latex_residue`) and Task 3 (`test_real_cv_has_no_residue`).
2. **Leak via nested braces:** an `\internal{...}` whose argument contains `{}` or `\href{..}{..}` must be dropped entirely. Pinned in Task 2 (`test_strip_internal_nested_braces`) and Task 11 (`test_site_has_no_forbidden_strings`).
3. **JavaScript off:** the full publication list, the email address (readable fallback), and a usable theme (system preference) must all work without JS. Pinned in Task 8 (`test_all_pubs_rendered_without_js`) and Task 6 (`test_email_fallback_present`).
4. **CV edits leaving stale sidecar keys:** a renamed or removed CV entry should give a build warning for `pub_extras.yml` / `cv_overrides.yml`, and an error (with the key named) for `research.yml`, never a crash or a silently broken link. Pinned in Task 4.
5. **Narrow phones (360px) and long words:** the hero stacks, the nav doesn't overflow, and long venue names or URLs wrap. Pinned by the screenshot check in Task 12 and `test_css_has_mobile_breakpoint` in Task 5.

```
build.py                      CLI: python build.py [--out _site] [--drafts]
requirements.txt              jinja2, pyyaml, markdown, pytest (pinned)

sitegen/cvparse.py            parse CV section files -> dicts
sitegen/data.py               load site.yml/profile/research/sidecars + generated JSON, merge, validate
sitegen/writing.py            load Markdown posts, Atom feed
sitegen/render.py             Jinja env, page rendering, sitemap, static copy
tools/import_cv.py            CLI: --cv-dir DIR --pdf FILE [--out content/generated]
content/site.yml              url, base_path, title
content/profile.yml           bio, lede, links, currently, selected_work
content/research.yml          7 themes
content/pub_extras.yml        per-pub-key: type, url, award, themes
content/cv_overrides.yml      per-entry replacement bullets / hide
content/generated/publications.json   (import-owned)
content/generated/cv.json              (import-owned)
content/writing/README.md     how to write a post (not rendered)
templates/base.html.j2, home.html.j2, research.html.j2, publications.html.j2,
templates/cv.html.j2, writing_index.html.j2, post.html.j2, 404.html.j2, _macros.html.j2
static/css/site.css
static/js/theme.js, static/js/pubs.js, static/js/email.js
static/fonts/*.woff2
static/img/IRCphoto.jpg, book-cover.png, favicon.svg, og.jpg
static/IndranilRoychoudhury_CV.pdf
.github/workflows/deploy.yml
tests/fixtures/*.tex
tests/test_*.py
README.md                     how to update, preview, deploy
docs/domain-move.md           registrar steps for Indranil
```

**Deviation from spec §7 (builder's call):** generated data is JSON (`publications.json`) rather than BibTeX. The CV's free-text citations don't map cleanly to BibTeX fields, and nothing downstream needs `.bib`.

### Task 2: LaTeX Utilities

**Files:** Create `sitegen/latex.py`, `tests/test_latex.py`

**Interfaces:**
- Produces: `strip_internal(tex: str) -> str`, `latex_to_html(tex: str) -> str`, `latex_to_text(tex: str) -> str`, `find_braced(s: str, start: int) -> tuple[str, int]` (returns the argument and the index after its closing brace; handles nesting and `\{`).

`strip_internal` order: remove `%` comments (not `\%`) to end of line; drop `\begin{internalblock}…\end{internalblock}`; drop `\internal{…}` and `\internalnew{…}` with brace matching; replace `\internalclear{X}` with `X`; replace `\ifinternalcv A\else B\fi` with `B` and `\ifinternalcv A\fi` with `""`; remove `\internalon`, `\internaloff`, `\internalnewon`, `\internalnewoff`.

`latex_to_html` maps `\textbf{x}` → `<strong>x</strong>`, `\emph{x}`/`\textit{x}` → `<em>x</em>`, `\href{u}{t}` → `<a href="u">t</a>`, `\url{u}` → link, `` `` `` / `''` → `“` / `”`, `` ` ``/`'` → `‘`/`’`, `---` and `--` → `–` (en dash; the em dash is banned), `~` → nbsp, `\&` `\%` `\$` `\_` `\#` → literal, `$\vert$` → `|`, accent commands (`\"{o}` `\'e` `\'{e}` `` \`a `` `\~n` `\c{c}`) → Unicode; drops `\hfill`, `\\`, `\vspace{…}`, `\needspace{…}`, `\textsc{…}` (keeps content), `\Large`, `\large`, `\small`; HTML-escapes text. `latex_to_text` = same, then strip tags.

  - `test_strip_internal_inline`: `"A.\internal{ secret IDF-1.} B."` → `"A. B."`
  - `test_strip_internal_nested_braces`: `"x\internal{ see \href{https://eureka.slb.com}{\textbf{y}} } z"` → `"x z"` (after whitespace collapse)
  - `test_strip_internalblock`: block between begin/end removed, text around it kept.
  - `test_ifinternalcv_else`: `"Patents and \ifinternalcv Invention Disclosures\else Patent Applications\fi"` → `"Patents and Patent Applications"`
  - `test_internalclear_kept`: `"\internalclear{kept}"` → `"kept"`
  - `test_comment_removed_but_escaped_percent_kept`: `"95\% ok % hidden"` → `"95\% ok "`
  - `test_latex_to_html_basic`: `` "``Title,'' \emph{SPE Journal}, 1350--1360" `` → `"“Title,” <em>SPE Journal</em>, 1350–1360"`
  - `test_no_latex_residue`: for a fixture string containing every construct above plus `\"{o}` and `\&`, assert the output has no `\`, `{`, `}`, or `—`.

### Task 3: CV Parser, Import CLI, and First Import

**Files:** Create `sitegen/cvparse.py`, `tools/import_cv.py`, `tests/fixtures/{publications,patents,honors,experience}.tex` (small hand-written excerpts in the real CV's structure, with one `\internal{}` each), `tests/test_cvparse.py`; generate `content/generated/publications.json`, `content/generated/cv.json`; copy the PDF to `static/IndranilRoychoudhury_CV.pdf`.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: Task 2 functions.
- Produces:
  - `parse_section(tex: str) -> dict`: `{"title": str, "intro_html": str, "groups": [{"title": str|None, "items": [Item]}]}`. A section title comes from `\textsc{\Large{…}}`; a group from `\item \textsc{\textbf{…}}`; an entry from `\item …` or `\bibitem[LABEL]{KEY} …`. `Item = {"key": str, "label": str|None, "html": str, "text": str, "children": [Item]}`. Nested `\begin{list}` inside an entry becomes `children`. Key = bibitem key, otherwise `slugify(text[:60])`.
  - `parse_experience(tex: str) -> list[dict]`: `{"key", "org", "location", "dates", "role", "bullets": [html]}` (header line: `\textbf{ORG, LOCATION} \hfill \textbf{DATES}\\ \textit{ROLE}`).
  - `extract_publications(pubs_section: dict, patents_section: dict) -> list[Pub]`: `Pub = {"key", "label", "type", "year": int|None, "title", "html", "text", "url": str|None, "award": str|None}`. Type comes from the group title: Book → `book`, Book Chapters → `chapter`, Journal Papers → `journal`, Conference Papers → `conference`, Technical Reports → `report`, Whitepapers → `whitepaper`, Theses → `thesis`, Granted U.S. Patents / Published Patent Applications → `patent`. The year is the last `(19|20)\d\d` in the text. The title is the text between the first `“` and `”`. The URL is the first `\href` target, if any. The award is a parenthetical matching `Best Paper` (e.g. "Nominated for Best Paper Award"), which is moved out of `html`. Patent key = the patent or publication number with non-alphanumerics removed (e.g. `US12608592`, `US20250315037`, `EP4630852`).
  - `tools/import_cv.py --cv-dir DIR --pdf FILE [--out content/generated]`: reads the section files named in spec §4 except `summary.tex`, `software.tex`, `technical-skills.tex`; drops the "Technical Talks at SLB" group; writes `publications.json` (list of Pub) and `cv.json` (`{"experience": [...], "education": section, "honors": section, "service": section, "talks": section, "teaching": section, "memberships": section}`); then runs `verify_against_pdf`.
  - `verify_against_pdf(items: list[str], pdf_text: str) -> list[str]`: normalize both (lowercase, Unicode quotes and dashes to ASCII, collapse whitespace, drop hyphenation at line breaks); return each item whose first 50 normalized chars are not found in the PDF text. The CLI exits nonzero and prints the misses if any.

### Task 4: Data Loading, Sidecars, Validation

**Files:** Create `sitegen/data.py`, `content/pub_extras.yml`, `content/cv_overrides.yml`, `tests/test_data.py`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `content/generated/*.json`.
- Produces: `load_content(root: Path) -> Content`, where `Content` is a dataclass with `site: dict, profile: dict, research: list[dict], pubs: list[dict], pubs_by_key: dict, cv: dict, posts: list[dict]` (posts filled by Task 10; `[]` until then) and `warnings: list[str]`. Raises `ContentError(msg)`.
- Merge rules: `pub_extras.yml` maps `KEY: {type?, url?, award?, themes?: [theme_id]}` onto pubs (fields override). `cv_overrides.yml` maps `experience: {KEY: {bullets: [str]} | {hide: true}}` and `honors|service|talks|teaching: {KEY: {html: str} | {hide: true}}`. Unknown keys in either sidecar → append to `warnings` (`"pub_extras.yml: unknown key 'X'"`). A `research.yml` theme `pubs: [KEY]` with an unknown key → `ContentError` naming the theme id and key. `build.py` prints warnings to stderr.

**Files:** Create `static/css/site.css`, `static/js/theme.js`, `static/fonts/` (download from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/fontsource/fonts/ibm-plex-sans@latest/latin-{400,500,600}-normal.woff2`, `…/ibm-plex-sans@latest/latin-400-italic.woff2`, `…/ibm-plex-mono@latest/latin-400-normal.woff2`; OFL, include `static/fonts/OFL.txt`), `static/img/favicon.svg` (monogram "IR" in accent teal), `templates/base.html.j2`, `templates/_macros.html.j2`, `templates/404.html.j2`, `tests/test_layout.py`. Modify `sitegen/render.py`, `build.py`.

**Interfaces:**
- Produces: blocks `title`, `description`, `head_extra`, `content` in `base.html.j2`; context var `nav = [("Research","/research/"),("Publications","/publications/"),("CV","/cv/")]`, plus `("Writing","/writing/")` when `posts` is non-empty; `page_id` for `aria-current`.
- Theme: an inline `<script>` in `<head>` **before** the stylesheet link reads `localStorage.theme`, falls back to `matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)')`, and sets `document.documentElement.dataset.theme`. CSS defines tokens on `:root` (light) and `[data-theme="dark"]`, plus `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root:not([data-theme="light"]) {…} }` so no-JS dark works. `theme.js` wires the toggle button (`button.theme-toggle`, label "light"/"dark" with ○/●, `aria-pressed`), saves to `localStorage`.
- Layout values from spec §6: max width 880px content, H1 44px / -0.028em, body 17px / 1.6, labels 12px uppercase 0.14em tracking, link underline via `text-decoration-color: var(--rule)` → accent on hover, focus ring `2px solid var(--accent)` offset 3px, `@media (max-width: 640px)` stacks hero and reduces H1 to 34px, `prefers-reduced-motion` disables transitions.
